items.headline: Flood Watch issued May 12 at 9:42AM AKDT until May 13 at 10:00AM AKDT by NWS Anchorage AK
items.description:

* WHERE...Kalskag, Kwethluk, Akiak and Tuluksak

items.headline: Hydrologic Outlook issued May 11 at 11:07AM AKDT by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
ESFAFG

...Locations Impacted...
Rampart and Tanana.

The Yukon River breakup front is currently downstream of Rampart.
The River Watch team will fly to Tanana today (Monday May 11th) to
report on surrounding ice conditions. Updates will be posted as
available.
